enemies.name: Grix the Goblin
enemies.flavor: The loudest goblin in the warren, crowned by the unbeatable logic that nobody dared say no. He hoards trophies, grudges, and a gnawed bone scepter he swears is royal.
enemies.strategy: A swelling green swarm: cheap bodies in ever-growing numbers. Answer with efficient area attacks and a line that won't be swamped while you thin the horde, or you'll simply be buried. Now and then a Warren Filcher slips past to rob you. Catch it on the way home to get your card back, or Grix plays it against you.
behaviors: Flanker-happy: 25% each round to send extra commander-hunters down your thinnest lane.

enemies.name: Slime Lord
enemies.flavor: A crowned ooze that was a king once, or ate one; the cave stories disagree. It rules the wet dark by simple arithmetic: whatever you cut in half comes back as two.
enemies.strategy: Every slime you strike splits, so chipping the tide only hands you more targets. Bring area damage and massed ranged fire to erase whole squads at once, before the ooze multiplies past anything your front line can hold.

enemies.flavor: No one has ever seen all of him at once. He is a crown of matted tails and a thousand red eyes in the dark, and he does not command the swarm so much as he is it.
enemies.strategy: His Swarm Rats shed a Ratling every time they're struck but live through the hit, so chip damage and glancing area clears just breed more rats, and his Rat Ogre bursts into a fresh litter when it dies. It's numbers, not poison: remove bodies outright with single-target burst that one-shots a rat before it splits, or he simply drowns you.

enemies.name: Gorehoof
enemies.flavor: A tusked beast-lord who wears his last three challengers as a cloak. He does not command the charge so much as be it, and the herd follows the biggest thing moving.
enemies.strategy: Every beast in the herd Charges, and Full Tilt hardens each one the moment its run-up is behind it, so the boar that reaches your line is tougher than the card says. Hold the line and blunt the rush. Shoot the chargers down on the approach, brace with Spearwall so the run-up buys nothing, and never leave a clear road to your commander.

enemies.name: The Broodmother
enemies.flavor: She has not left her egg-choked hollow in an age; she doesn't need to. The webs bring her everything, wrapped and patient, and her children are always hungry.
enemies.strategy: Stacking venom that spreads. Her Blightspray plants Contagion: a slow-burning Poison pool that every couple of seconds may leap to a nearby unit (friend or foe, a plague picks no sides), so a tightly-packed line rots wholesale as it chains from body to body. Keep your army spread out so the contagion has nowhere to hop, cleanse it if you can, and win before it eats you from the inside. Each new case is weaker, so spacing really does starve it out.

Adapts to your board: swaps in a squad to answer swarm and big compositions.

enemies.name: Wynken, the Dreaming
enemies.flavor: An old man asleep in the middle of the war, and it is his dream you are standing in. He does not wake for the noise. He simply dreams you smaller.
enemies.strategy: He fights in his sleep. Sweet Dreams aims at your densest cluster and Polymorphs those units into 1/1 Sheep for 10 seconds, and a 1 HP Sheep in the front line does not usually get 10 seconds, so a deck leaning on one star unit is handing it to the flock. Go wide, keep your line cheap and replaceable, and don't bunch up. A Sheep that lives out its 10 seconds comes back at the health it had, so screening one is worth a card. His slow Sleepwalkers dream what they strike into Sheep too (they swing rarely, so screen them), and fast Nightmares Fear-bite your backline. Worst of all, Night Terrors aims at his own thickest knot of Sleepwalkers and Nightmares and upgrades them into powerful Sleep Demons for good, so thinning his crowd before he casts matters as much as protecting yours. Commanders can't be dreamed, so yours is safe; nothing else is.

enemies.name: Wally
enemies.flavor: The friendliest man in the friendliest village you will ever march through. He will wave. The whole village will wave. Notice how nobody blinks, how the shutters are closed at noon, and how everyone's eyes catch the light like coins. Do try to be gone by moonrise.
enemies.strategy: This fight runs on a real sky. The sun crosses it in two rounds, and when the moon rises Wally, every villager on the field and the whole watching crowd turn into wolves, then turn back at daybreak. Wounds carry across the change, so a wolf you bloody tonight wakes as a villager far too small to hold that wound and dies where it stands. Hurt things while they are big and let the sunrise collect. Wally works the same trick on himself, doubling his own health bar at moonrise and halving it back at dawn, which is why a hit landed on him by day is worth two landed by night. Keep your line loose once it is dark, because his Howling Madness turns your own soldiers on whatever stands nearest them, friend or foe. And if you push him under half while the sun is still up, he will not wait for the moon. He drags it up early.
behaviors: Spells: casts starting round 3, about every 2 rounds.

enemies.name: Vitrix, the Kilnmaiden
enemies.flavor: Vitrix pulls her soldiers from the kiln still glowing and sends them to war before they cool. They are beautiful, brief, and entirely too sharp, like their mistress, who considers every shattered battalion a finished piece.
enemies.strategy: A glass army built entirely around Fragile: the next hit on a marked unit strikes double. Kilnborn blows leave the mark, her Vitrify glass-coats whole clusters, and her Kiln-Glaze power makes the cracks propagate: every few seconds a Fragile unit passes the mark to its nearest unmarked neighbour. The payoff is the Glass Lancer: a pouncing, slow-swinging literal glass cannon whose enormous lance blow cashes the doubled damage out of whatever mark it lands on, and shatters at a touch in return. Spread out so the cracks can't travel, rotate marked bodies away from the lancers, and kill the brittle things at reach before they connect.

enemies.name: Thorax Clawdinson
enemies.flavor: Thorax Clawdinson walked to the North along the bottom of the sea, a red king crab who heard there was a better shore at the end of the dark. A thousand fathoms down he found a hammer that had fallen out of the sky, and nobody worthy was there to lift it, so he picked it up with his claw. The lightning went through his shell like a song and never stopped playing. He came up in the fjords with a storm on his back, hauled a longship up the beach, filled its hull with eggs, and has been dancing on that shore ever since.
enemies.strategy: Break the clutch before it hatches, and stay out of his water when the lightning comes. His Clutch Drakkar lays eggs and wells up Tide Pools, he lays more clutches straight onto the pools, and the Crablings that hatch grow big in the water. Every time he loses a quarter of his health the tide surges in and more pools well up under your army, and any lightning that touches a pool (Hammerfall, his Coilbacks, the Ball Lightnings of The Drop) turns it to Live Wire, which his Insulated crabs shrug off. At half health he moults: the old shell stands in his centre road as a wall, and for a few seconds the soft crab under it takes extra damage. Burn the eggs and the ship fast, keep your line out of the pools, and bring anything Insulated.

enemies.flavor: He is the King of Chess, yet he began his life as a mere pawn. By braving death on the front lines to strike down the enemy king, he forged a kingdom of his own. Unlike the arrogant, noble-born kings, this king, who rose from the humblest of origins, knows how to protect himself with absolute thoroughness and unyielding strength. A veteran of the battlefield, he possesses the mastery to crush his adversaries with overwhelming, devastating force.
enemies.strategy: His board is the rules: laser walls cross it at every rank and switch on and off, so every piece, yours and his, waits at the line and steps a square at a time. Speed buys little here. Pawn Barracks in every file keep pawns coming, Knights leap the lasers in L's, Rooks shell from behind a plated row, and Bishops slant up the files healing and turning your poisons, burns, and hexes into buffs. At half health he promotes a pawn to his Queen, who walks straight through the lasers and hits like a siege. Break the barracks early, keep reach on the Bishops, and kill the Queen fast.

Brass Sappers hunt your commander and burst where they are stopped, so keep a guard at home that can take the blast. His Foundry Override rebuilds nothing and lets the current loose across the floor. His Juggernauts and Sappers are armored, so bring burn, poison or heavy single hits.

enemies.strategy: A maiden's touch Silences (on-death pops, counters, splits, auras, all switched off while the mark lasts), so ability-reliant armies fight at half their sheet, and The Hush blankets whole clusters in it. The armored Mute Bell joins her line that same round and rings once on death, silencing whoever broke it, so don't send your cleverest pieces to finish it. Lead with plain stat-line muscle, or kill the maidens before they lay hands on your tricks.

enemies.name: Perihelion, the Fallen Star
enemies.flavor: An age ago something crossed the whole of the night to reach this mountain, and the Frostspire has been cold ever since. It is not winter around Perihelion. It is distance: the cold of the gap between stars, still radiating out of a heart that never finished falling.
enemies.strategy: Event Horizon picks a huge circle of ground and folds everything of yours standing in it into one tight knot, and then Starfall comes down on the knot and the ground just ahead of it, so the survivors walk out from under the sky rather than step out of it. Its Gravity Toss is the same trick reversed: your whole army is thrown back down its lanes, and every body that lands on your commander takes a bite out of it, which makes a fresh line still bunched at your muster spots a danger to the crown that paid for it. Braced Spearwalls hold their ground through every fold and stationary engines never move an inch, so a planted line stands outside the falling sky; everyone else must spread their deploys wide enough that one circle cannot take the lot. The star itself never marches, and its host is thin crystal: break it and walk into the light.

enemies.flavor: Not a creature but a season given a face: the killing frost, walking. Where it stands, the world simply stops being warm.
enemies.strategy: Winter itself. Nothing sneaks and nothing feints (the only lord in the war who never sends flankers), just one inexorable front of golems and rime-reavers over a field that keeps freezing, while the season casts like nothing else: Flash Freeze entombs your densest cluster in solid ice (Stunned, and Fragile when the block shatters, so don't clump), and scheduled avalanches roll down a lane gathering mass from every body they crush. A deep unbroken line feeds the snowball, so screen it with something cheap and let the monster die small. At half health: Whiteout. Bring burst that lands regardless of tempo, and keep your army loose.

enemies.strategy: The breakup. The ice under this fight breaks up as he is hurt. From Breakup (60%) pieces calve off the edges of the floes; from 45% whole floes break away, the outer ones first, until one is left. Everything on ice that breaks away is lost, and every break is outlined, with a cast bar, before it goes. His penguins swim back (Born Swimmers). Yours do not. The centre floe never breaks: put what you cannot afford to lose in the middle, keep cheap bodies on the outside, and stay off outlined ice. Flyers lift clear of a breaking floe. On the last floe the ice rocks like a seesaw, and walking downhill is faster than walking up.

keywords.text: After running a short distance, its next strike deals +4 damage.

keywords.name: Chain 1
keywords.text: Each attack strikes 1 more enemies.

keywords.name: Flanker
keywords.text: Ignores enemy units and rushes straight to the commander.

keywords.name: Armor 1
keywords.text: Reduces every hit it takes by 1.

keywords.name: Ice Saw
keywords.text: Every 8 seconds it saws loose the ice it stands on. Anything on that ice is lost to the sea.

keywords.name: Armor 1
keywords.text: Reduces every hit it takes by 1.

keywords.name: Taunt
keywords.text: Redirects attacks at nearby allies to itself.

keywords.name: Cleave
keywords.text: Each attack also strikes every other enemy around the target.

keywords.name: On Death
keywords.text: summons 6 Waddlers

keywords.name: Flanker
keywords.text: Ignores enemy units and rushes straight to the commander.

spells.name: Belly Flop
spells.text: Deals 6 damage to units in a Medium area and knocks them outward. Units knocked off the ice are lost.

spells.name: Fish Supper
spells.text: Looses 4 shots at your commander for 3 each. Each defender near it blocks one.

warlords.name: King
warlords.title: Warlord of the Realm
warlords.text: The crown that started it all. Marches out with loyal levies and a heart that refuses death once an act. No other warlord gets a second chance.
warlords.pin_text: Grants 1 extra life. Recharges each act.

warlords.name: Mummy
warlords.title: Warlord of the Old Tombs
warlords.text: A pharaoh three thousand years past his funeral, still collecting tribute. His soldiers barely hit hard enough to bruise, and they have never needed to. Everything they touch is already rotting.
warlords.pin_text: Statuses you apply are doubled. Your units deal 75% attack damage.

warlords.name: Spaceman
warlords.title: Warlord of the High Orbit
warlords.text: He planted a flag on the moon and declared everything under it his. His engineers tune the weight of the ground itself, and the roads he fights on grow heavy or light on his schedule. Nothing out here stays where you put it.
warlords.pin_text: Your lanes run fast or slow. A Slow Lane drops all movement to 0.75x, a Fast Lane speeds it to 1.5x. The lanes flip each round.

warlords.name: Gunslinger
warlords.title: Warlord of the Frontier
warlords.text: Six bullets, no patience. Rode into the war looking for the one bounty big enough to retire on: everything. Every hand in his outfit carries a gun, and not one of them means to let you close.
warlords.pin_text: Your ranged units deal double attack damage. Your melee units deal half.
warlords.unlock: Finish a run, win or lose.

warlords.name: Eternal
warlords.title: Warlord of All Eras
warlords.text: Every crown, every era, every war: the same king behind them all. Nothing he has won is ever truly over, so he rides out still carrying pieces of the last one.
warlords.pin_text: Begin each run with 1 pin and 2 cards from your last winning run.
warlords.unlock: Climb the Ascension ladder to its top rung.

warlords.name: Boxer
warlords.title: Warlord of the Ring
warlords.text: Heavyweight champion of four eras, undefeated in five. Every soldier he takes is drilled the way he was raised: chin down, fists up, close the distance. Anything that fights from farther than arm's reach he calls a coward's tool, and pays accordingly.
warlords.pin_text: Your melee units deal double attack damage. Your ranged units deal half.

warlords.name: Pirate
warlords.title: Warlord of the High Seas
warlords.text: She declared war on every coastline and most of the rivers. Where other warlords muster an army, she takes on crew: anyone, from anywhere, so long as they can swing a cutlass and keep quiet about the manifest. The hold is never full.
warlords.pin_text: Draft a fourth pack at the start of each run.

warlords.name: Witch
warlords.title: Warlord of the Deep Fen
warlords.text: The fen sent her an eviction notice once. Once. She brews doubles of everything on principle, keeps her soldiers small, crooked and expendable, and considers a fair fight a failure of preparation.
warlords.pin_text: Your potions pour twice. +2 potion slots.

warlords.name: Viking
warlords.title: Warlord of the Frozen Shore
warlords.text: He counts a warrior's worth in scars, which prices an unbloodied soldier at roughly nothing. His people fight harder the worse the day goes, and the sagas only remember the ones who never came home. He keeps the sagas busy.
warlords.pin_text: Your wounded units deal double attack damage.
warlords.unlock: See 1,000 of your warriors fall in battle.

warlords.name: Ninja
warlords.title: Warlord of the Moonless Night
warlords.text: Nobody has seen his army. Several have seen pieces of it, briefly, exactly where an army had no business being. He considers the front line a suggestion, walls a rumor, and the moonless night a personnel carrier.
warlords.pin_text: Your units that cost 1 energy or less can be summoned anywhere on the field.
warlords.unlock: Win 25 battles without your commander taking a scratch.

warlords.name: Train Conductor
warlords.title: Warlord of the Timetable
warlords.text: He ran the one railway the Old Empire ever finished, and he still keeps its timetable. His army leaves the platform slow and arrives unstoppable: every round the boiler builds a little more pressure, and he has never once been early.
warlords.pin_text: Your energy starts at 1 and climbs by 1 each round, up to 6.

warlords.name: Explorer
warlords.title: Warlord of the Uncharted
warlords.text: She has mapped every realm the Old Empire lost and several it never found. Roads are for people who need to be told where they are going. She reads the land itself, and the land has never once said no.
warlords.pin_text: No road binds you: from any node, march to any node in the next row.

warlords.name: Dragon
warlords.title: Warlord of the Hoard
warlords.text: Every coin she has ever been paid, stolen or slept on is still under her. She fights the way she counts: nothing leaves the hoard that does not come back with interest, and an army is only one more thing to pay for.
warlords.pin_text: You may play cards you can't afford. Every missing energy costs 5 gold.

warlords.name: Cyborg
warlords.title: Warlord of the Grafted Host
warlords.text: Whatever beat him, he kept. Half his body is other people's work and so is half his army, and every commander who falls to him hands over a card he will be playing by the next morning. There is nothing left of the man who started the march.
warlords.pin_text: Gain 1 enemy card after defeating each enemy commander.

warlords.name: Crash Dummy
warlords.title: Warlord of the Test Track
warlords.text: He has been driven into the same concrete wall eleven thousand times, and the chart on the lab door records every one. A lord who stands up in a new shape halfway through a fight is one more impact for the chart, and each one he walks away from leaves him running a little hotter than the last.
warlords.pin_text: Each enemy phase break gives you 1 energy and +1 max energy.

warlords.name: The Wedded
warlords.title: Warlords of the Aisle
warlords.text: They were married on the morning the war reached their village and marched straight out of the chapel. He leads his groomsmen at the front of the line, she leads her bridesmaids behind it, and they stand close enough to hold hands. Each carries half a commander's strength. If one of them falls in battle, the other fights on, and a win brings the fallen one back with 1 HP.
warlords.pin_text: Your spouse marches beside you as an AI commander with their own deck.

warlords.name: Barbarian
warlords.title: Warlord of the Broken Gates
warlords.text: He came down out of the hills with an axe older than the kingdom and has broken the gate of every walled town on the road since. He does not lead from the back. Once he is badly hurt, the red mist comes down, and he walks into the enemy line himself, shrugging off half of every blow.
warlords.pin_text: Below half health, your commander Rages: it charges down the lane at the enemy commander and takes half damage.

keywords.name: Armor
keywords.text: Reduces every hit it takes by its armor value (min 1).

keywords.name: Shield
keywords.text: Prevents damage before HP. Slowly regenerates.

keywords.name: Cleave
keywords.text: Each attack also strikes every other enemy around the target.

keywords.name: Chain
keywords.text: Each attack strikes more enemies near the target.

keywords.name: Fork Chain
keywords.text: Each hit splits in two at every enemy it reaches, then splits again.

keywords.name: Lifesteal
keywords.text: Heals itself for a share of the damage it deals.

keywords.name: Healer
keywords.text: Heals the most wounded ally in range instead of attacking.

keywords.name: Flanker
keywords.text: Ignores enemy units and rushes straight to the commander.

keywords.name: Pickpocket
keywords.text: Deals no damage. Steals one of your cards for its commander to play. Kill it on the way home to get the card back.

keywords.name: On Strike
keywords.text: Triggers each time this unit lands a hit.

keywords.name: Predate
keywords.text: It leaps onto the enemy with the most max HP that is taking Bleed, anywhere on the field.

keywords.name: Aim High
keywords.text: Shoots the enemy with the most max HP in range.

keywords.name: Giant Slayer
keywords.text: Deals double damage to the enemy with the most max HP on the field. Commanders don't count.

keywords.name: Uncanny
keywords.text: An enemy it hits, or that hits it, turns away and can't target it for a few seconds.

keywords.name: Jealous
keywords.text: An enemy that strikes an ally in its range is its next target and takes double damage.

keywords.name: Devotion
keywords.text: Enemies that defect to your side gain an On Strike Charm while a unit with Devotion stands.

keywords.name: Star-Crossed
keywords.text: Bound to one enemy. When one of the two dies, so does the other.

keywords.name: Sabotage
keywords.text: Enemies summoned near it arrive Fragile. While hidden it holds still and doesn't attack.

keywords.name: Nightshade
keywords.text: Each hit it lands on the enemy commander costs them health at the start of every round, for the rest of the battle.

keywords.name: Sleeper
keywords.text: It arrives disguised in the enemy ranks, then unmasks and Silences the enemies around it.

keywords.name: Fan Mail
keywords.text: Every few enemies that die in its range mail the enemy a Curse.

keywords.name: Door Policy
keywords.text: While it stands, the enemy draws every Curse in their deck at the start of their turn, and must play them before anything else.

keywords.name: Shock Tactics
keywords.text: Deals double damage to a Stunned target.

keywords.name: Troop Transport
keywords.text: Allies it passes climb aboard and can't be hit. It drops them all when it meets the enemy or breaks.

keywords.name: Fanfare
keywords.text: Ongoing: the first summon you play each round that has an On Deploy triggers it twice.

keywords.name: Ram
keywords.text: Shoves every unit out of its path, then crashes into the enemy commander and breaks.

keywords.name: Grim Harvest
keywords.text: Every few ally deaths restore its Undying 1.

keywords.name: Inheritance
keywords.text: On Death: the next unit you summon this battle gains its attack and max HP.

keywords.name: Hearse
keywords.text: Your units that die near it are carried inside. When it's destroyed, they climb out at full health.

keywords.name: Procession
keywords.text: When the last of its Mourners falls, what they carry rises.

keywords.name: On Deploy
keywords.text: Triggers the instant the unit is summoned.

keywords.name: Stationary
keywords.text: Cannot move.

keywords.name: Bombard
keywords.text: Shells the enemy commander on a timer, from anywhere on the field.

keywords.name: Ice Saw
keywords.text: On a timer, it saws loose the ice it stands on.

keywords.name: Rootreach
keywords.text: On a timer, sends a root down its lane to strike the first enemy it meets.

keywords.name: Laser
keywords.text: On a timer, its gun hand fires at the nearest enemy in its long range, beside its own attack.

keywords.name: Fireborn
keywords.text: Immune to enemy Burn. Its own side's Burn heals it.

keywords.name: Retaliate
keywords.text: Strikes the attacker back with its own attack.

keywords.name: Thorns
keywords.text: Every blow it takes deals the listed damage straight back to the attacker.

keywords.name: Ethereal
keywords.text: Can be summoned onto a used tile and passes through allies.

keywords.name: Neutral
keywords.text: Belongs to no army. Either side can attack it.

keywords.name: Free Deploy
keywords.text: Can be summoned anywhere.

keywords.name: Backstab
keywords.text: Strikes from behind, on the victim's own commander's side, deal double damage.

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.text: Enemies cannot target it until it strikes.

keywords.name: Coin-Fed
keywords.text: Its gun is loaded with your gold: 1 gold buys the listed number of shots.

keywords.name: Frenzy
keywords.text: Each attack adds a stack of attack speed, which fade when not attacking.

keywords.name: Recoil
keywords.text: Each shot it fires costs it the listed health, past any armor or shield.

keywords.name: On Kill
keywords.text: Triggers whenever this unit kills an enemy.

keywords.name: On Death
keywords.text: Triggers when this unit dies.

keywords.name: Soul Harvest
keywords.text: Triggers whenever an ally dies.

keywords.name: Scourge
keywords.text: Every few seconds, it lays the listed statuses on itself.

keywords.name: Hat Stack
keywords.text: Each hat gives it the listed attack. Every point of damage it takes knocks a hat off first.

keywords.name: Charge
keywords.text: After running a short distance, its next strike deals bonus damage.

keywords.name: Mounted
keywords.text: Increases movement speed, grants Charge 2, and takes the first hit for the rider.

keywords.name: Spearwall
keywords.text: A charging attacker loses its Charge bonus and takes damage back, as does a Flanker that strikes it.

keywords.name: Taunt
keywords.text: Redirects attacks at nearby allies to itself.

keywords.name: Scattershot
keywords.text: Each shell lands at a random spot near its mark and detonates, hurting friend and foe alike.

keywords.name: Pounce
keywords.text: With no enemy in blade-reach, it leaps at one within its pounce range, crossing lanes to do it.

keywords.name: Undying
keywords.text: Instead of dying, it returns at 1 HP with its statuses cleared. Spends one use.

keywords.name: Slimify
keywords.text: On death, summons the listed number of copies of itself at half health.

keywords.name: Slayer
keywords.text: Deals bonus damage to one specific class of enemy.

keywords.name: Terror Feeder
keywords.text: Its blows land multiplied against a target that is already Feared.

keywords.name: Hivemind
keywords.text: Every direct hit is spread evenly across all friendly Hivemind units.

keywords.name: Brood
keywords.text: Every few seconds, summons the listed unit.

keywords.name: Polymorph
keywords.text: Replaces the target with the named unit for 10 seconds.

keywords.name: Hatch
keywords.text: After its timer the hatchling bursts out, and the spent shell counts as a death.

keywords.name: Moonrise
keywords.text: After its timer it turns into the named werewolf.

keywords.name: Daybreak
keywords.text: After its timer it turns back into the named villager.

keywords.name: When Struck
keywords.text: Triggers when attacked by an enemy.

keywords.name: When Damaged
keywords.text: Any damage this unit survives triggers the listed effect, whatever dealt it.

keywords.name: When Hit
keywords.text: Every direct hit it takes triggers the listed effect, even one Invulnerable cancels.

keywords.name: Charm Aura
keywords.text: Enemies near it steadily gain Charm until they defect.

keywords.name: Healing Aura
keywords.text: Wounded allies near it steadily heal.

keywords.name: Defector
keywords.text: A fully Charmed enemy. It changed sides and now fights for the army that Charmed it.

keywords.name: Idol
keywords.text: Deals bonus attack damage for every defector in your army.

keywords.name: Wingman
keywords.text: Gains its bonus every time an enemy within a wide reach of it defects, and keeps it for the fight.

keywords.name: Chorus
keywords.text: Its On Strike Charm also lands on every enemy next to the one it hits.

keywords.name: Greed
keywords.text: Deals bonus attack damage for every 30 gold you have.

keywords.name: Crash-Tested
keywords.text: Each enemy phase break makes it untouchable until your next turn.

keywords.name: Commander
keywords.text: Immune to spells unless a card says it strikes commanders. Strikes back when struck.

keywords.name: Slime
keywords.text: Immune to Poison and Contagion.

keywords.name: Bog-Born
keywords.text: Immune to Poison and Contagion.

keywords.name: Spore-Born
keywords.text: Immune to Poison and Contagion.

keywords.name: Frostproof
keywords.text: Can't be Slowed.

keywords.name: Insulated
keywords.text: The Live Wire floor doesn't shock it.

keywords.name: Bloodless
keywords.text: Can't Bleed.

keywords.name: Cinderborn
keywords.text: Burning ground doesn't sear it. Burning still does.

keywords.name: Swimmer
keywords.text: Can't be Slowed. Moves faster through a Tide Pool.

keywords.name: Tideborn
keywords.text: Slow heals it instead of slowing it.

keywords.name: Spellproof
keywords.text: Enemy spells can't target or harm it.

keywords.name: Pool Deploy
keywords.text: Can also be summoned onto any Tide Pool.

keywords.name: Knight's Move
keywords.text: Leaps instead of walking, always forward and one file over. The file it lands in becomes its own.

keywords.name: Diagonal
keywords.text: Walks the diagonals, turning only at the edge of the board.

keywords.name: Transmute
keywords.text: Each heal turns the patient's harmful statuses into buffs.

keywords.name: Royal
keywords.text: The laser walls part for it.

keywords.name: Pool Dweller
keywords.text: Can only be summoned onto a Tide Pool. That pool never dries up while it lives, and spreads every round.

keywords.name: Tidecaller
keywords.text: Gains attack for each Slowed enemy on the field.

keywords.name: Riptide
keywords.text: Its strikes drag the target toward it.

keywords.name: Blood in the Water
keywords.text: Deals double damage to a Slowed target.

keywords.name: Red Wake
keywords.text: Any Tide Pool it stands in turns to Red Tide.

keywords.name: Wellspring
keywords.text: A Tide Pool wells up where it stands, again and again.

keywords.name: Big Fish
keywords.text: Grows bigger and stronger the bigger the Tide Pool it's in.

keywords.name: Tide Rush
keywords.text: In a Tide Pool it moves and attacks twice as fast.

keywords.name: Fisherman
keywords.text: Each strike swaps the fish it fights with, in turn: a Swordfish, a Pufferfish, and an Eel.

keywords.name: Deluge
keywords.text: Can only be summoned onto a Tide Pool or Soft Water. On Deploy, every road floods with that water for a few seconds.

keywords.name: Shotgun
keywords.text: Each shot hits every enemy in a short cone in front of it.

keywords.name: Bounty
keywords.text: Deals double damage to an enemy a trap caught in the last few seconds.

keywords.name: Lure
keywords.text: Enemies within a large range walk toward it instead of your army.

keywords.name: Burrow
keywords.text: When no enemy is near, it buries itself again as a trap. The next one to spring it brings it back out at full health.

keywords.name: Sea Change
keywords.text: Grows stronger in a Tide Pool and stronger still in Red Tide. Wounds and statuses carry over.

keywords.name: Unlock
keywords.text: Activates a new ability at or above the listed Max HP.

keywords.name: Overheal
keywords.text: Any healing past full becomes max HP.

keywords.name: Decay
keywords.text: Loses max HP every second and dies when none remains. Healing refills only what is left.

keywords.name: Swell
keywords.text: Gains max HP every second, and heals the same.

keywords.name: Long Cleave
keywords.text: Each attack also strikes every other enemy around the target, twice as far out as Cleave.

keywords.name: Airborne
keywords.text: Flies over the fight: only ranged attacks can hit it. Spells and blasts still reach it.

keywords.name: Shoulders
keywords.text: Riders shoot from its shoulders with +50% range and can't be hit. When it falls they are set down at its feet.

keywords.name: Volley
keywords.text: On a timer, every unit from the same card fires at once at the same enemy, on top of its own attacks.

keywords.name: Grapple
keywords.text: Every other strike throws the target into the enemy behind it.

keywords.name: Horde Guard
keywords.text: While enough of your other units stand near it, no blow can take it below 1 HP.

keywords.name: Interest
keywords.text: While this unit stands, the IOUs in your hand grow at the end of each turn.

keywords.name: Locked Horns
keywords.text: It and its foe fight only each other, and no other unit can hit either of them, until one falls.

keywords.name: Caseload
keywords.text: Its attack rises and falls with the number of cards in your hand, live.

keywords.name: When You Discard
keywords.text: Triggers whenever you discard a card while this unit is on the field. Loaded bullets carry over between turns.

keywords.name: Hoarder
keywords.text: Takes every Hive gift your Bugs share, multiplied, and shares none of its own.

keywords.name: Mending Aura
keywords.text: Doubles all healing and max HP gains for allies near it, itself included.

keywords.name: Coin Toss
keywords.text: Flips a coin, 50/50 before Luck. Lucky pays the listed payoff.

keywords.name: Round Start
keywords.text: Triggers as each round's fighting begins.

keywords.name: Bookie
keywords.text: Grows each time one of your Coin Tosses comes up Unlucky.

keywords.name: Coin Guard
keywords.text: Flips a coin on every direct hit this unit takes. Lucky and the blow bounces off; anything else lands double.

keywords.name: Wild Die
keywords.text: Every strike rolls the die and adds it to its attack damage.

keywords.name: Nine Lives
keywords.text: Each death flips a coin. Lucky and it gets back up at full health, up to nine times.

keywords.name: Wheel Strike
keywords.text: Every strike rolls one of the listed outcomes.

keywords.name: Hive
keywords.text: While this unit is fielded, all your Bugs gain the listed boon. Copies stack.

keywords.name: Bug
keywords.text: Counts as a Bug for the rest of the battle: it joins your Hive and shares every gift your fielded Bugs give.

keywords.name: Explosive
keywords.text: Its shots detonate on impact, dealing full attack damage to every enemy around the blast.

keywords.name: Mystery Payload
keywords.text: Every shot flings a different payload at the target.

keywords.name: Burning Aura
keywords.text: Enemies near it catch fire on a steady beat, no attack needed.

keywords.name: Stun Aura
keywords.text: Enemies near it are Stunned on a steady beat, no attack needed.

keywords.name: Fear Aura
keywords.text: Enemies near it catch Fear now and then, no attack needed.

keywords.name: Madness Aura
keywords.text: Every unit near it, yours included, goes Mad on a steady beat.

keywords.name: Repair Crew
keywords.text: Heals your siege units.

keywords.name: Sanguine
keywords.text: Triggers when you lose health.

keywords.name: Pyromancer
keywords.text: Gains attack for each enemy currently with Burn.

keywords.name: Spirit Rites
keywords.text: Nearby allies gain On Death: Summon a Ghost.

keywords.name: Absorb Aura
keywords.text: Poison and Contagion on it or on allies near it are eaten instead. Each stack eaten gives it +1 attack and +1 max HP.

keywords.name: Acid Aura
keywords.text: Enemies touching it take damage every second and are Slowed, no attack needed.

keywords.name: Blessed
keywords.text: Harmful statuses land on it at half strength, and it can't be Charmed.

keywords.name: Self-Sacrifice
keywords.text: When an ally near it would die, it dies in that ally's place and heals the ally to full.

keywords.name: Intercession
keywords.text: Harmful statuses on allies near it move onto it, and units Charmed away from you come back near it.

keywords.name: Blinding Aura
keywords.text: Enemies near it are Blinded on a steady beat, no attack needed.

keywords.name: Frost Nova
keywords.text: Now and then it blasts the enemies around it with frost, damaging and Slowing them.

keywords.name: Pavise
keywords.text: On a timer, gives the nearest ally in front of it a Shield, or refills a damaged one.

keywords.name: Pay Back
keywords.text: Charges the last enemy that hit it, ranged or not.

keywords.name: Reverse
keywords.text: Harmful statuses never land on it. Each goes back onto the enemy that laid it, even one immune to it.

keywords.name: Execute
keywords.text: Kills outright an enemy it strikes and leaves under the listed HP, at the listed chance or on the listed strike. Never a commander.

keywords.name: Body Snatcher
keywords.text: When it kills a unit, it becomes a full-health copy of that unit, still a Body Snatcher.

keywords.name: Ongoing
keywords.text: Lasts only while this unit is on the field. Silence switches it off.

keywords.name: Troop
keywords.text: While it stands, nearby allies gain this bonus. Being near more than one does not add up.

keywords.name: Pack Tactics
keywords.text: Gains its bonus once for every other nearby ally.

keywords.name: Wedding Party
keywords.text: Gains its bonus once for every ally of the named kind on your side.

keywords.name: Mixed Crew
keywords.text: Gains its bonus once for every different kind of ally near it. Many of one kind count once.

keywords.name: Channeling
keywords.text: Every spell you cast leaves it permanently stronger.

keywords.name: Spellfire
keywords.text: Whenever you play a spell, it hurls a fireball at the nearest enemy for the listed damage.

keywords.name: Overcharge
keywords.text: Every spell you play gives it more Chain, for as long as it stays on the field.

keywords.name: Intangible
keywords.text: No damage lands on it until it makes its first attack.

keywords.name: Merge
keywords.text: When two of these meet, they fuse into the named unit.

keywords.name: Reabsorb
keywords.text: Slimelings of yours that touch it merge into it, and it gains their attack and max HP. When it dies, they all burst back out.

keywords.name: Glutton
keywords.text: Grows whenever an allied Slime near it dies.

keywords.name: Engulf
keywords.text: Swallows an enemy it strikes. An enemy that dies inside returns as a slime copy on your side.

keywords.name: Mix
keywords.text: Two Colorful Slimes that share no color merge into the color they make together.

keywords.name: Stack
keywords.text: Stack Slimes climb onto each other. A tall enough stack lobs from range, and topples forward when its bottom slime dies.

keywords.name: Absorb
keywords.text: Turns into a slime of the last terrain it touched: immune to that ground, with a power of it.

keywords.name: Take Root
keywords.text: Grows into the tree of the terrain it stands on, and Broods that tree's own fruit. It keeps the form when the terrain is gone, until it touches another.

keywords.name: Silencing Aura
keywords.text: Enemies near it are Silenced on a steady beat, no attack needed.

keywords.name: Slimed
keywords.text: An enemy an Engulfer digested, spat back out as a slime copy that fights for you.

keywords.name: Glue
keywords.text: Glues the enemy it strikes to the nearest other enemy for a few seconds. Damage either one takes hits the other too.

keywords.name: Bounce Pad
keywords.text: An ally that steps onto it is flung over the enemy front line into their back rank.

keywords.name: Crown
keywords.text: When it dies, the nearest Slime of yours is crowned in its place, with half its max HP and attack, and this same rule.

keywords.name: Launcher
keywords.text: Instead of striking, each attack lobs the listed unit down beside its target.

keywords.name: Trap
keywords.text: Triggers when an enemy is near.

keywords.name: When You Draw
keywords.text: Triggers every time you draw a card during your turn, but not for the 5 cards dealt at its start.

keywords.name: Vigilante
keywords.text: When an ally is attacked, it blinks to the attacker and strikes back.

keywords.name: Sidekick
keywords.text: Fights beside your closest Vigilante. With none left, it goes for the enemy commander.

keywords.name: Death Curse
keywords.text: On death: adds a curse to one of your piles.

keywords.name: Hex
keywords.text: When it strikes your commander, it plants a curse card in one of your piles.

keywords.name: Curse Feeder
keywords.text: It enters play with +1 attack and +4 HP for every curse in your deck, up to 5, and summons that many Hexlings, up to 3.

keywords.name: Cursed
keywords.text: Deals half damage and has half its max HP.

keywords.name: Heckle
keywords.text: Whenever anyone plays a Curse, it hurls the listed damage at the nearest enemy.

keywords.name: Amped
keywords.text: Whenever you play a Curse, it gains +1 attack.

keywords.name: Spite
keywords.text: When it dies, the enemy that killed it gets a Curse.

keywords.name: Cuss
keywords.text: The first time it strikes an enemy commander, that enemy gets a Curse.

keywords.name: Infamy
keywords.text: It arrives stronger for every Curse in your deck.

keywords.name: Coin Slot
keywords.text: Every Curse played drops the listed gold in it. Win a battle with this standing, and gain that much gold.

keywords.name: Pass It On
keywords.text: Whenever you play a Curse, the enemy gets one too.

keywords.name: Blood Store
keywords.text: Each point of Blood Price you pay fills your closest jar with room. Win the battle with it standing and your commander heals what it holds.

keywords.name: Blood Link
keywords.text: Each strike it makes deals damage to your own commander, never the enemy's.

keywords.name: Blood Bond
keywords.text: Whenever your own commander loses health, this unit heals that much.

keywords.name: Penance
keywords.text: Whenever it strikes or is struck, it gains attack and max HP, up to a cap.

keywords.name: Bloodrage
keywords.text: While your commander is below half health, it attacks twice as fast.

keywords.name: Slumber
keywords.text: It won't move or attack until it is struck, the time runs out, or your commander loses enough health.

keywords.name: Bloodied
keywords.text: It grows for each tenth of your commander's health that is missing.

keywords.name: Trick or Treat
keywords.text: When it reaches the enemy commander, it draws you a card and leaves.

keywords.name: Unresting
keywords.text: On Death: it rises 3s later with +50% attack and max HP, immune to whatever killed it. Each rise spends 1.

keywords.name: Meleeproof
keywords.text: Melee attacks can't harm it.

keywords.name: Rangedproof
keywords.text: Ranged attacks can't harm it.

keywords.name: Shrapnel Shield
keywords.text: When its Shield breaks, it bursts for damage to enemies nearby.

keywords.name: Mantlet
keywords.text: While its Shield holds, it and allies near it take half damage from ranged attacks.

keywords.name: Oathsworn
keywords.text: It stays by your commander. While its Shield holds, every attack aimed at your commander hits it instead.

keywords.name: Fast Rebuild
keywords.text: Its Shield rebuilds twice as fast.

keywords.name: Pierce
keywords.text: Each shot also hits every other enemy in its target's lane.

keywords.name: Fires on the Move
keywords.text: It keeps moving while it shoots.

keywords.name: Organ Volley
keywords.text: As each round's fight starts, it fires down every lane at the first enemy in each.

keywords.name: Lasting Growth
keywords.text: If it is standing when you win a battle, its card Permanently keeps part of the max HP it grew, up to a cap.

keywords.name: Rupture
keywords.text: At the listed max HP it ruptures, damaging enemies nearby, and shrinks back down. It can rupture again.

keywords.name: Fruiting
keywords.text: On a timer it adds a Fruit to your hand. Fruit costs 0: gain 1 energy, then it Exhausts.

keywords.name: Regrow
keywords.text: On Death: it regrows where it fell at the start of the next round. Each regrowth spends 1.

keywords.name: Giant's Ladder
keywords.text: Each time its max HP reaches the next step, a Young Giant climbs down it.

keywords.name: Wandering
keywords.text: With nobody to heal, it walks with your army instead of marching on the enemy.

keywords.name: Spreading Flame
keywords.text: Its Chain leaps to an enemy that is not burning yet whenever one is in reach.

keywords.name: Mirror Cast
keywords.text: Whenever you cast a damage spell, it casts a weaker copy at the enemy nearest to it.

keywords.name: Rekindle
keywords.text: On Death: it leaves Ashes. Cast any spell on the Ashes and it rises again at full health.

keywords.name: Kindle
keywords.text: Triggers whenever a Burning enemy dies nearby. Each death summons only one, however many are near it.

keywords.name: Blight Shot
keywords.text: Each shot leaves Blight where it lands for a few seconds. Your units cross it unharmed.

keywords.name: Cinder Shot
keywords.text: Each shot leaves Smouldering Cinders where it lands for a few seconds.

keywords.name: Fester
keywords.text: An enemy carrying 3 different afflictions erupts once, copying them all onto enemies near it.

keywords.name: Plague Herald
keywords.text: Every enemy that arrives on the field gets random afflictions that deal no damage.

keywords.name: Exhaust
keywords.text: When played, the card is removed from the game.

keywords.name: When Exhausted
keywords.text: Fires when the card is exhausted, by play or by any other effect.

keywords.name: When Drawn
keywords.text: Fires each time you draw the card. The gain lasts the battle.

keywords.name: Any Exhaust
keywords.text: Triggers whenever you exhaust a card while it is on the field.

keywords.name: Sacrifice
keywords.text: To play the card you destroy one of your own units.

keywords.name: Permanent
keywords.text: The card keeps the gain for the rest of the run, through every battle.

keywords.name: Growth
keywords.text: Applies the effect every 3 seconds.

keywords.name: Exp
keywords.text: Each kill by this card's units banks 1 Exp for the rest of the run. A full bar pays out, then resets.

keywords.name: Achieve
keywords.text: Meet the goal shown and the card keeps the gain for the rest of the run. Each new goal is a little bigger.

keywords.name: Luck
keywords.text: Each stack makes Coin Tosses land Lucky 10% more often, gives Wild Dice an extra roll, and tilts wheels toward the better wedges.

keywords.name: Blood Price
keywords.text: To play this card your commander also takes the listed damage.

keywords.name: Motley
keywords.text: Costs 0 once you play cards from N different packs this turn.

keywords.name: Retain
keywords.text: Stays in your hand at the end of the turn.

keywords.name: When Retained
keywords.text: Fires each time the card stays in your hand at the end of a turn. The gain lasts the battle.

keywords.name: Captured
keywords.text: A Hollow copy of an enemy your unit killed, with half its HP and attack and all of its keywords. It Exhausts instead of being discarded.

keywords.name: Innate
keywords.text: Starts in your opening hand.

keywords.name: Auto-Play
keywords.text: When you draw this card, it plays itself if you can afford it.

keywords.name: Stalk
keywords.text: When you play another summon while this card is in your hand, it plays itself for free.

keywords.name: Reluctant
keywords.text: You can't play this card. If it is in your hand at the end of your turn, it plays itself for free.

keywords.name: % Chance
keywords.text: Every listed chance rolls on its own when triggered.

keywords.name: Random Affliction
keywords.text: One of Burn, Poison, Bleed, Slow, Stun, Fear, Fragile, Blind, Charm, Silenced, or Contagion, rolled fresh each time.

keywords.name: Curse
keywords.text: A card that works against whoever holds it. One given to the enemy goes into their next hand.

keywords.name: Bleep
keywords.text: Your next Curse costs 0 and does nothing to you.

keywords.name: Rage
keywords.text: Your commander takes half damage and charges the enemy commander, cleaving everything in reach.

keywords.name: Burn
keywords.text: Deals fire damage every second for 3 seconds. Ignores armor and shields.

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.text: Deals 1 damage per second, ignoring armor and shields.

keywords.name: Contagion
keywords.text: Spreading Poison: more damage the more infected units are near it (max 6).

keywords.name: Regen
keywords.text: Heals a little each second until it runs out.

keywords.name: Fear
keywords.text: Cannot fight; flees back toward its own commander.

keywords.name: Slow
keywords.text: Moves and attacks at half speed.

keywords.name: Stun
keywords.text: Cannot move or attack.

keywords.name: Charm
keywords.text: Switches sides once its stacks reach its remaining HP. Swooning at half that.

keywords.name: Swooning
keywords.text: Fights at half attack damage until the Charm fades or the unit defects.

keywords.name: Fragile
keywords.text: The next hit deals +100% damage and spends one stack.

keywords.name: Vulnerable
keywords.text: Each direct hit deals extra damage equal to its stacks, then spends one.

keywords.name: Bleed
keywords.text: Takes damage as it moves and when it attacks.

keywords.name: Blind
keywords.text: Its next attack misses and clears one stack.

keywords.name: Silenced
keywords.text: Its keywords and abilities are switched off.

keywords.name: Invulnerable
keywords.text: Each direct hit is cancelled and spends one stack.

keywords.name: Madness
keywords.text: Attacks whatever is nearest, friend or foe.

keywords.name: Infest
keywords.text: If it dies, a Lab Rat crawls out for the side that infested it for each stack, up to 3.

keywords.name: Rot
keywords.text: Every heal it would take deals that much damage instead, Regen and Lifesteal included.
